Technical requirements captured: average baseline traffic ~4-8 req/s across support endpoints; peak burst observed ~120-180 req/s for 30-120s during promotions; target chat latency <300ms p95; prefer smaller cheaper model for plain-text routing, with automatic fallback to higher-quality model if latency budget allows. Also asked for guidance on exponential backoff with jitter and recommended circuit-breaker thresholds (suggested: 3 consecutive 429s -> pause for 2s + backoff).

Commercial: SMB price-sensitivity — likely to commit to paid hosted tier if we demonstrate fewer rate-limit incidents and clear quotas they control in console. Ask: quick docs + console walkthrough showing how to bump burst window for paid customers, and an emergency support path for quota spikes.

Security/compliance: currently PII-light (ticket text + email), but they want audit logging and SSO later. No immediate need for private/VPC.

POC asks (explicit): run synthetic spike test (2x, 5x, 10x over baseline) against hosted_api with customer's sample traffic pattern and return metrics: 429 count, average latency, token cost delta. Provide recommended throttling config (per-key burst window, concurrency ceiling) and developer-friendly retry examples (HTTP headers to inspect, pseudo code for backoff with jitter).

Sales notes: good inbound intent (self-serve trial used up). Low friction to convert if POC shows improved behavior. Priority: 1) technical POC 2) console quota controls 3) written retry guidance.
